title: 第6章 能力还得配身份！
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

贺舟在听到提示时，眼神里浮现几丝惊喜。

可一点开时，笑容僵住了。

【猫科平衡、夜间视物、警觉耳、骑摩托…】

底下还有不少的黑猫警长的能力，比如【巡逻直觉】【追踪嗅觉】【临时拘束】等…

但是全部都是灰色。

一眼看去，都是增加了各种兑换条件。

至少都是要求角色身份达到路人或者炮灰等级以上的。

临时拘束这种有反抗能力的能力，更是需要一万点人气，角色身份也要求达到高光炮灰。

最便宜而且自己用得上的一个能力则是【警觉耳】，底下的介绍也很简单。

【警觉耳·零阶】

【来源：《黑猫警长》第一话的NPC猫】

【效果：可偶尔捕捉到十分微弱的异常声响。】

【兑换身份：NPC】

【兑换人气：0】

【下一级：警觉耳·一阶】

【升级需求：角色身份达到背景板、1人气值】

还能升级？

人气还需要一点？

贺舟长叹了一口气。

所以说，最重要并不是能力，是人气，是角色人气！

漫画人气越高！

关注的人才越多！

关注的人越多，自己在角色高光戏份时涨的人气才越高！

角色身份升级了才能有更好的能力！

不然自己现在身份达不到，人气累计不够，就算是画出《鬼灭之刃》《咒术回战》也用不了。

还是得先找一些简单的画一下。

而底下还有一行小字。

【注：不符合《妖怪都市》世界观的能力将被自动筛选。】

也就是说…

迪迦奥特曼自己可以画，但是能力不符合的话，会被筛选掉，不会出现在兑换栏里。

贺舟此时已经开始思考《黑猫警长》之后，自己应该画什么了。

先把东西给兑换了吧。

贺舟十分麻溜地先把警觉耳给兑换了下来。

【是否兑换：警觉耳·零阶？】

【兑换成功。】

“这怎么回事！”

“这不是我画的剧情啊！”

当田小西看到第八话生出来的下一格情节时，人都傻了。

只见在下一格里，她期待的江黛奄奄一息被男主角路安拯救的画面并没有出现。

男主角路安原本有了出门的念头。

可走到门口时，又犹豫了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When He Zhou heard the prompt, there was a hint of surprise in his eyes.

But when he opened it, his smile froze.

[Feline balance, night vision, alert ears, motorcycle riding...]

There are also many abilities of Sheriff Black Cat, such as [Patrol Intuition], [Tracking Smell], [Temporary Restraint], etc...

But it's all gray.

At a glance, various exchange conditions have been added.

At least they all require the character to be above the passerby or cannon fodder level.

Temporarily restraining the ability to resist requires 10,000 points of popularity, and the role's identity also requires high-gloss cannon fodder.

The cheapest ability that you can use yourself is [Alert Ear], and the introduction below is also very simple.

【Alert Ear·Zero Level】

[Source: NPC cat from the first episode of "Black Cat Sheriff"]

[Effect: Occasionally very weak abnormal sounds can be captured.】

[Redemption identity: NPC]

[Exchange popularity: 0]

[Next level: Alert Ear·Level 1]

[Upgrade requirements: Character identity reaches the background board and 1 popularity value]

Can it still be upgraded?

Need more popularity?

He Zhou let out a long sigh.

Therefore, the most important thing is not ability, but popularity, and role popularity!

The more popular comics become!

The more talents you pay attention to!

The more people follow you, the more popular you will be in the highlight scenes of your character!

Only when your character's identity is upgraded can you have better abilities!

Otherwise, if I don't reach my current status and my popularity is not enough, I won't be able to draw "Demon Slayer" or "Jutsu Kaiba" even if I draw it.

I still have to find some simple drawings first.

And there is a line of small words at the bottom.

[Note: Abilities that do not conform to the world view of "Yōkai City" will be automatically screened.】

That is to say…

Ultraman Tiga can be drawn by himself, but if his abilities do not meet the requirements, he will be filtered out and will not appear in the exchange column.

He Zhou had already begun to think about what he should draw after "Black Cat Sheriff".

Let's exchange the things first.

He Zhou quickly exchanged the alert ears first.

[Would you like to redeem: Alert Ear·Level 0?】

[Redeem successful.】

"What's going on!"

"This is not the plot I drew!"

When Tian Xiaoxi saw the next plot in Chapter 8, everyone was dumbfounded.

In the next frame, the scene she was expecting of Jiang Dai dying and being saved by the male protagonist Lu An did not appear.

The male protagonist Lu An originally had the idea of ​​going out.

But when he reached the door, he hesitated again.
